summary: Phase W3 real-time WebSocket sync VERIFIED WORKING end-to-end across two independent authenticated browser contexts on WEB preview. WS connects to /api/ws?token=... on login; on a mutation in Session B the backend broadcasts {"type":"invalidate","path":"/api/fundraisers"} which Session A receives live; Session A's focused Home screen auto-refetched and the 'Raised' widget updated from $240.00 -> $282.00 (= previous total + the $42 fundraiser B just created) without any manual pull-to-refresh or tab switch by user A. No console errors originated from RealtimeContext; logout path (storage clear + reload) does not crash. Test selectors on desktop sidebar could not target the Money > Fundraisers segment (sidebar labels it 'Expenses' not 'Money' on wide layout), but the Home aggregate widget provides equally strong proof of the useRealtimeRefetch hook firing on a focused screen. Deprecated packages detected: none new — only a benign RN Web warning props.pointerEvents is deprecated (pre-existing, unrelated to Realtime).

react_native_issues.issue: console warning: props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents. Not from RealtimeContext; a pre-existing warning from an unrelated component. Non-blocking.

action_items: None required for Phase W3 real-time sync — feature is verified working. Optional: track down source of the pointerEvents deprecation warning (unrelated to this phase).
critical_code_review_comments: RealtimeContext.tsx: initial rev value stored in lastHandled on first useEffect run correctly prevents a spurious refetch on mount. Good.
Exponential backoff (2s..30s cap) with reset on ws open + AppState 'active' re-connect covers mobile background/foreground transitions.
connect() guards against stacking sockets by checking readyState — solid.
core/realtime.py ConnectionManager is in-process; comment already notes Redis pub/sub is needed for multi-worker. Acceptable for now.
seed_data_creation: One test fundraiser 'RT1785282730' ($42) was created via Session B and remains in the applereview@cheerplanner.app household. Main agent may want to delete it after review.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Two-context WebSocket real-time test recipe: (1) navigate to /login (root path shows a marketing landing on wide viewport, only mobile viewport auto-routes to login); (2) fill 2 inputs then click 'Sign in' exact-text button; (3) desktop sidebar uses label 'Expenses' (not 'Money'); (4) to reach Fundraisers segment from desktop, click sidebar 'Expenses' then data-testid=tab-fundraisers; (5) subscribe to page.on('websocket') to capture ws.framereceived — invalidate frames arrive as {"type":"invalidate","path":"/api/<resource>"}; (6) Home screen 'Raised' aggregate is a great low-effort proof-point because it uses useRealtimeRefetch and re-computes from /api/fundraisers.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bug. Verified acceptance: WS connects (1 /api/ws open), invalidate frame delivered to Session A after Session B POST /api/fundraisers, focused Home screen auto-refetched and 'Raised' aggregate updated from $240.00 to $282.00 (delta = $42, matching the fundraiser amount created in B). No console errors from RealtimeContext. Logout (localStorage clear + reload) does not throw.
